# Weekly source review

From the research folder, run `python3 weekly-source-review.py` for a one-time review. On the Mac that holds the folder, run `python3 weekly-source-review.py --install` from a logged-in desktop session to generate the first report and register a LaunchAgent. It runs Mondays at 9 a.m. in the Mac’s local time zone. Leave the user session signed in for unattended runs.

The job follows the lookup in `prompts/lookup.md`. It treats top-level list items in `notes/index.md` as catalog entries. A list item can link to a source note under `notes/`, or match the note’s filename stem or first level-one heading by title. The report flags missing or ambiguous matches and lists PDFs under `source/` by filename. It inventories PDFs without extracting their text.

Each run replaces `reports/weekly-source-review.md`. Scheduled runs write output and errors to `reports/weekly-source-review.out.log` and `reports/weekly-source-review.err.log`. All inputs and outputs stay on the Mac.

import argparse
import hashlib
import os
import plistlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import NamedTemporaryFile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
INDEX = ROOT / "notes/index.md"
REPORT = ROOT / "reports/weekly-source-review.md"
LABEL = "local.research." + hashlib.sha256(os.fsencode(ROOT)).hexdigest()[:16]

LIST_ITEM = re.compile(r"^(?:[-*+]|\d+[.)])\s+(.+)$", re.MULTILINE)
LINK = re.compile(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)")
HEADING = re.compile(r"^#\s+(.+)$", re.MULTILINE)


def normalized(text):
    return " ".join(re.findall(r"\w+", text.casefold()))


def review():
    notes = {}
    for path in sorted((ROOT / "notes").rglob("*.md")):
        if path == INDEX:
            continue
        heading = HEADING.search(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        names = {normalized(path.stem)}
        if heading:
            names.add(normalized(heading[1]))
        notes[path] = names

    pdfs = sorted((ROOT / "source").rglob("*.pdf"))
    entries = LIST_ITEM.findall(INDEX.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    lines = ["# Weekly source review", "", "## Catalog entries", ""]
    if not entries:
        lines.append("No catalog entries are listed in notes/index.md.")

    for entry in entries:
        links = LINK.findall(entry)
        local_links = [target for _, target in links if "://" not in target]
        linked_notes = {
            (INDEX.parent / target.split("#", 1)[0]).resolve()
            for target in local_links
            if target.lower().split("#", 1)[0].endswith(".md")
        }
        title = normalized(LINK.sub(r"\1", entry))
        matches = (
            sorted(linked_notes.intersection(notes))
            if linked_notes
            else [path for path, names in notes.items() if title in names]
        )
        if len(matches) == 1:
            status = f"Source note: {matches[0].relative_to(ROOT)}"
        elif matches:
            status = "Ambiguous: " + ", ".join(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)) for path in matches)
        else:
            status = "Source note missing"
        lines.append(f"- {entry} — {status}")

    lines.extend(["", "## PDF inventory", ""])
    lines.extend(f"- {path.relative_to(ROOT)}" for path in pdfs)
    if not pdfs:
        lines.append("No PDFs found under source/.")

    REPORT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=REPORT.parent, delete=False) as output:
        temporary_path = Path(output.name)
        try:
            output.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
            output.close()
            temporary_path.replace(REPORT)
        finally:
            temporary_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    print(REPORT.relative_to(ROOT))


def install():
    launch_agents = Path.home() / "Library/LaunchAgents"
    launch_agents.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    REPORT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    plist = launch_agents / f"{LABEL}.plist"
    domain = f"gui/{os.getuid()}"
    job = {
        "Label": LABEL,
        "ProgramArguments": [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve())],
        "WorkingDirectory": str(ROOT),
        "StartCalendarInterval": {"Weekday": 1, "Hour": 9, "Minute": 0},
        "StandardOutPath": str(REPORT.parent / "weekly-source-review.out.log"),
        "StandardErrorPath": str(REPORT.parent / "weekly-source-review.err.log"),
    }
    if subprocess.run(["launchctl", "print", f"{domain}/{LABEL}"], capture_output=True).returncode == 0:
        subprocess.run(["launchctl", "bootout", f"{domain}/{LABEL}"], check=True)
    plist.write_bytes(plistlib.dumps(job))
    subprocess.run(["launchctl", "bootstrap", domain, str(plist)], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["launchctl", "print", f"{domain}/{LABEL}"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    print("Registered for Mondays at 9:00 a.m. in the Mac's local time zone.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Review the research catalog and its source notes.")
    parser.add_argument("--install", action="store_true", help="Register the weekly macOS LaunchAgent.")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    review()
    if args.install:
        install()
